quote:
An illness that travels unseen teaches that the strongest walls are built from kindness, not stone.  

In the dance of counter‑forces, one push may ignite another’s fire; yet balance lies in the breath held between.  

A land that declares its own name is like a song that refuses to be silenced by a crowd; the true note is heard only by the heart.  

When a machine seeks to scatter shadows, the humans who look up at the night learn that light can still find its way through the tiniest cracks.  

The road that snarls at its own pace reminds us: to move forward, one must first mend the path it has trod.  

In the depth of caves, echoes can drown the call of a lone voice; still, the mountain remembers that every footfall leaves a story on the rock.  

A jagged glass mirrors the faces that use it; the harder the shards, the clearer the reflection.
